w: This evening Swamishri personally blessed 20 medical students and 190 twelfth grade students for their final exams in March.

In the evening assembly Swamishri advised. "Through regular spiritual association of a holy sadhu one benefits from the fruits of satsang. But today no one has time to come every day, so they come once a week and participate in a daily home discourse and thus experience the fruit of spiritual association. By reading or listening to the Vachanamritam one comes to associate with Shriji Maharaj. Similarly, by listening and imbibing the talks of Gunatitanand Swami and the life of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, one comes to associate with Gunatitanand Swami, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj respectively. And with this one's conviction grows stronger and eventually one is redeemed from one's baser instincts. Only when we associate with a bonafide Guru do we come to realise our true nature and the glory of God."

After Swamishri's blessings, Pujya Shri Acharya Dharmendraji Maharaj, a profound scholar, speaker and Vaishnavacharya, arrived. He was honored and welcomed by Swamishri on his birthday with a garland of flowers and he too in turn also garlanded Swamishri. In his blessings, Acharya Dharmendraji Maharaj explained, "....Today in our age we see the growing influence of Kaliyuga and its darkness. And on the other hand having the darshan of sadhus like Pramukh Swami Maharaj one is blessed with the power of fearlessness. One also experiences inner consolation and confidence... God comes with His powers and manifests through a sadhu. We are proud to say that we have such a manifest form of God in Pramukh Swami Maharaj..."
Swamishri blessed a kishore who had prostrated (dandvat-yatra) his way from Dhrol to Bhadra, performing 4,855 prostrations.
Swamishri visited the holy banyan tree and farm sanctified by Mulji Sharma, and prayed for rain.
In the morning, Gunatitanand Swami's diksha anniversary assembly was held, wherein the saintliness of Gunatitanand Swami and his glory as Akshar was sung.
From 12 midnight to 3.30 am Swamishri, sadhus and devotees were engaged in devotion during the lunar eclipse.
The third day of the 3-day Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebrations. (News report)

The grand finale assembly of the Swaminarayan Bicentenary Celebration was held on a festive scale. The towering colorful stage backdrop glowed with aesthetic and divine grandeur. The assembly commenced at 4.20 pm with the Swaminarayan dhun and prayers. Pujya Anandswarup Swami talked about the scientific benefits of meditation and mantra chanting.

Then Pramukh Swami Maharaj presented a model home to the Chief Minister of Gujarat Shri Narendrabhai Modi, symbolizing the reconstruction of 9 villages and colonies and 43 schools in Kutch, Surendranagar and Rajkot districts by BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha. Addressing an assembly of 125,000 devotees, Shri Narendra Modi commended the extraordinary services of the Sanstha during the earthquake relief operation. He mentioned, " On reflecting upon the life of Bhagwan Swaminarayan, one sees that His life was dedicated in the service of the poor and suffering souls of society. Service, compassion and love for society was His dharma. There has not been any calamity or catastrophe where one would not find Pramukh Swami Maharaj and his sadhus alleviating the sufferings and pain of victims. I ask Pramukh Swami Maharaj to pray to God to redeem Gujarat from calamities that have been affecting it often."

Swamishri then blessed Shri Narendrabhai Modi. The program was interspersed with speeches, traditional theme dances and dramas. Shri Bhupendrasinh Chudasama, Minister for Narmada Dam Project, lauded the works of Swamishri. Pujya Dr Swami, Pujya Brahmdarshan Swami, Pujya Atmaswarup Swami, Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami, Pujya Viveksagar Swami and Pujya Mahant Swami discoursed on the history, significance and glory of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra. The popular verse, ' Swaminarayan mahamantrani jalhal jyot jagavo ...' was sung by sadhus and chorused by the mammoth assembly. The brief impressive dramas portrayed the supremacy and power of the Swaminarayan mahamantra through stories of Shitaldas, Khimo Suthar and Naja Jogiya. A beautiful dance based on the bhajan ' Swaminarayan Mahamantrano Jagma Jay Jay Kar Chhe…' was exquistively performed by youths. An impressive video on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's efforts in spreading the glory of the Swaminarayan mantra was screened to the joy of the congregation.

Prior to his blessings, the giant congregation chorused the Swaminarayan dhun sung by Swamishri, for peace to prevail in India and for the eradication of terrorism in India and the world. Finally, the assembly was crowned with the blessings of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He said, "The Swaminarayan Mahamantra has the divine power to redeem one from the cycle of births and deaths. One finds spiritual wisdom in the scriptures but only through the Guru can one realize the knowledge and power of the mantra. One finds different types of power in this world; there is physical power, political power, money power but they all pale into insignificance before grave problems in life. However, the power of God sustains us in the face of all challenges. Hanumanji, through his faith in Lord Ram, was able to cross over to Lanka. So, the power of God is the highest power and the solution to all our problems."

ph: The devotees ritually donate their land for the construction of a mandir

w: At 6.00 p.m., a special assembly of dignitaries, invitees and devotees was held in the BAPS mandir hall. The subject of the assembly was ‘Relevance of Spirituality in the 21st Century.’ After the ritual dhun and prayer a short video about an introduction to BAPS was shown. Pujya Yagneshwar Swami gave the welcome address followed by a speech in English from Pujya Vishwamurti Swami, a bhajan by Pujya Krishnapriya Swami and a speech in Hindi by Pujya Viveksagar Swami. Dr. P.C. Rao, former law secretary for Government of India, spoke glowingly of Hindu dharma and Swamishri’s services to society. Thereafter, the chief guest, Shri Devendra Gupta, a High Court judge of Andhra Pradesh, addressed the assembly. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, elaborating upon the life and work, and message of Bhagwan Swaminarayan in making mankind happy
ph: H.E. T. N. Chaturvedi, Governor of Karnataka, greets Swamishri

w: “I read but by my mind is restless,” revealed a student to Swamishri. “When you read with the belief that you will not be able to do it then nothing works. Strive more and pray to stabilise your mind. If you read properly then you won’t have problems. Before reading chant ‘Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan’. Do it and your mind will not be restless. Don’t give up or get bored. You have my blessings. You’ll get confidence and strength.” “But I cannot remember after reading,” the student added. “First resolve in your mind that you want to study. And if you read with that attitude then you won’t have problems. But when you want to just roam around, then how can you remember!”

ds.t: The touch of the philosopher's stone
w: Prayasvinbhai had appointed a man named Niranjanbhai Maharana to look after the arrangements for Pramukh Swami Maharaj and the sadhus. He used to bristle even at the name of the Swaminarayan Sampraday, but the magic of Swamishri's saintliness and divinity had its effect on him, because Niranjan Maharana, who used to run from the very name, was now hovering around Swamishri. The dislike he had at first had melted away. He came early in the morning and stayed on his feet until late at night, so his wife said, "You are not going to become a sadhu, are you?"
Then, going home late at night, he said jokingly with a laugh, "It might even happen. So phone your father in Bihar."

And his wife really did phone her father, and some quick reactions began to come, so Maharana said to his wife, "You too come once for darshan at Pramukh Swami Maharaj's puja." And one day she too came to the puja, and it was as if the philosopher's stone touched her too.
One could feel that the saying "Ek ghadi, adhi ghadi..." (even a moment, even half a moment, in the company of a sadhu...) was coming true here.

ds.t: Half a moment of good company
w: To look after Swamishri and the sadhus, Prayasvinbhai had appointed a man named Niranjanbhai Maharana. He used to bristle even at the name of the Swaminarayan Sampraday, but the magic of Swamishri's saintliness and divinity worked on him, because Niranjan Maharana, who once ran from the very name, was now always moving around Swamishri. The dislike he had at first had melted away. He would come early in the morning and stay on his feet until late at night, so his wife said, "You are not going to become a sadhu, are you?"
Going home late at night, he laughed and joked, "It might even happen. So phone your father in Bihar."

And his wife really did phone her father, and some quick reactions began, so Maharana told his wife, "You too come once for darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's puja." And one day she too came to the puja, and it was as if the philosopher's stone touched her too.
It felt as if the idea of 'Ek ghadi adhi ghadi...' (a moment, even half a moment, of good company) was proving true here.

To celebrate the first of two parts of the Jholi festival more than 7,000 devotees had assembled in the evening assembly. The devotees were seated in the Yogi Sabhagruh, Yogi Mandapam and several floors on Pramukh Sadan.Pujya Viveksagar Swami spoke about the significance and glory of the Uttarayan festival. Thereafter a drama titled “A unique assembly of askhar muktas for Jholi” written by Adarshjivan Swami was enacted by youths. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “If one has devotion what can one not sacrifice? Dada Khachar gave his entire property to Shriji Maharaj. Maharaj put him through many trials, but he was a bona fide devotee and passed. The five Pandavs and King Ambrish were put to the test and they too passed.”

After darshan in the mandir, giving darshan to all the devotees, Mahant Swami Maharaj came near the lift of the sadhus' ashram. Here Rahuldas Swami held a drum on Vishwaviharidas Swami's head and, beating it, said, "Vishwavihari Swami says, 'The drums of death are beating on my head...'" Everyone laughed.
Entering the lift, Swamishri said, "Of joy..."
"Wah!" came from everyone's lips.
By changing just one letter, from mot (death) to moj (joy), Swamishri led everyone to joy, the fruit of what we have attained.
